game.prefixActive: Prefix key active, press next key...

objectives.2-4-convert: Join and break panes: keep 2 windows, eliminate 'temp'
objectives.2-8-sync: Enable pane synchronization in at least one window
objectives.3-1-option: Use set-option to change a configuration
objectives.3-1-split: Use bind-key to bind a shortcut and split a pane
objectives.3-5-splits: At least one window with 2+ panes
objectives.3-7-splits: At least one window with 3+ panes
objectives.3-7-names: All windows must have custom names

hints.1-1-1: Type tmux or tmux new -s <name> to create a session
hints.1-2-1: Use Ctrl+b " for horizontal split, Ctrl+b % for vertical
hints.1-2-2: You need to use both split directions
hints.1-3-1: Use Ctrl+b Arrow keys to navigate panes
hints.1-4-1: Use Ctrl+b x to close current pane
hints.1-4-2: Navigate to the target pane first
hints.1-4-3: Or type exit to close the pane
hints.1-5-1: You need to create 4 panes total
hints.1-5-2: Split horizontally first, then split each pane vertically
hints.1-5-3: Ctrl+b " → select top → Ctrl+b % → select bottom → Ctrl+b %
hints.1-6-1: Use Ctrl+b z to zoom a pane
hints.1-6-2: Navigate to target pane first, then press Ctrl+b z
hints.1-6-3: Ctrl+b → to p2, then Ctrl+b z to zoom
hints.1-7-1: Use Ctrl+b c to create a new window
hints.1-7-2: Press Ctrl+b c twice to have 3 windows
hints.1-7-3: You already have 1 window, create 2 more
hints.1-8-1: Use Ctrl+b n/p to switch windows
hints.1-8-2: Or use Ctrl+b <number> to select directly
hints.1-8-3: Press Ctrl+b 2 to switch to window 3
hints.1-9-1: Use Ctrl+b , to rename current window
hints.1-10-1: Use Ctrl+b d to detach from session
hints.1-10-2: After detaching, use tmux attach to reconnect
hints.1-11-2: editor needs vertical split, logs needs horizontal split
hints.1-11-3: Create windows and name them, then split
hints.2-1-1: Use Ctrl+b Ctrl+Arrow to resize panes
hints.2-1-2: Press Ctrl+b Ctrl+→ multiple times to enlarge right
hints.2-2-1: Use Ctrl+b Space to cycle preset layouts
hints.2-2-2: Press multiple times to cycle through layouts
hints.2-3-1: Use Ctrl+b { or } to swap panes
hints.2-3-3: Select the pane and press Ctrl+b {
hints.2-4-1: First use :join-pane to merge the temp window
hints.2-4-2: Then use Ctrl+b ! to break a pane into a new window
hints.2-5-1: Use Ctrl+b [ to enter copy mode
hints.2-5-2: Entering copy mode copies content to clipboard
hints.2-6-2: This makes all panes receive the same input
hints.2-7-1: Use tmux new -s <name> to create named sessions
hints.2-8-1: Start by creating a second session
hints.2-8-2: Create multiple windows in each session
hints.2-8-3: Don't forget to enable pane sync
hints.3-1-1: Type :set -g prefix C-a to change prefix
hints.3-2-1: Type :set -g mouse on to enable mouse
hints.3-2-2: After enabling, click to switch panes
hints.3-2-3: Then use Ctrl+b Arrow to navigate to p2
hints.3-3-2: Also set status-right for time display
hints.3-5-1: Create session first, then windows and splits
hints.3-5-3: Create session → new windows → split panes
hints.3-6-3: Switch to utils session first, then move window
hints.3-7-2: Create session, then create and name each window
hints.3-7-3: Window names cannot be the default 'bash'

tutorial.1-10-step1: First, use Ctrl+b d to detach from the session
tutorial.1-10-step2: Now use tmux attach -t mywork to reconnect
tutorial.3-1-step1: Type :set -g prefix C-a to change the prefix key
tutorial.3-1-step2: Use :bind-key to bind a custom shortcut
tutorial.3-2-step1: Type :set -g mouse on to enable mouse mode
tutorial.3-2-step2: Now navigate to the second pane
